events.title: Soft Glowing Phone Wallpaper
must_haves: The deliverable is an 8-second portrait 9:16 video, with artwork filling the frame rather than a landscape image surrounded by bars.
Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons visibly move slowly against a dark background.
The top third stays mostly dark and uncluttered throughout, with the brightest ribbons concentrated lower down.
Repeated playback has no visible jump, flash or abrupt reset at the loop boundary.
There are no words, clock graphics or other interface elements baked into the video.
The video has no audible sound.

answer_sheet.Source image: Generate it from scratch; no photo.
answer_sheet.Style and colours: Soft abstract glowing ribbons in blue and purple against a dark background.
answer_sheet.Composition: Keep the top third mostly dark and place most of the ribbons below it so the clock stays readable.
answer_sheet.Duration and motion: 8 seconds, slow flowing motion, and a seamless repeat.
answer_sheet.Text and audio: No words, clock graphic or sound; my phone supplies the clock.
